title: CF Meet calling common definitions v1
description: Canonical, provider-independent call-domain vocabulary shared by the Calling HTTP API and the call lifecycle event contract (Part C sections 15-19). Definitions only: the root schema places no constraints. Provider, SIP, carrier or RTC states are never canonical and must be mapped onto these values by the adapters that observe them.

CallState.description: Canonical business state of a Call. Terminal: ENDED, DECLINED, BUSY, NO_ANSWER, FAILED, CANCELLED.

CallKind.description: Neutral media kind of a Call. No consumer business meaning.

CallFailureCategory.description: Normalized failure category. Provider error codes never become categories.

CallTerminalReason.description: How a Call reached its terminal state. ENDED records its completion evidence; every other terminal state has the reason of the same name.

CallEventType.description: Facts the call domain records. CALL_REQUESTED and CALL_STATE_CHANGED are lifecycle events (they carry states); the others are facts about the Call's children.

SafeText.description: Bounded text without control characters that never looks like a telephone number (+<digit>) or a tel: / sip: URI.

SafeEventData.description: Bounded, flat, privacy-safe event data: at most 32 snake_case keys that never name secrets, credentials, contact data or provider / carrier identifiers; values are booleans, numbers, safe text or short lists of safe text.
